notes: Two failure modes stacked, and the corpus should record both because they decay differently. The permanent one is the faculty gate: postdocs and graduate students must route through a full-time faculty member, and there is no independent-researcher lane. The transient one is the closed portal: the vendor page says not accepting, a third-party portal page says 'Application Halted', and a June 2026 forum thread shows the 30 June round closing early. Worth re-checking each quarter rather than marking dead, because NVIDIA has run this as a rolling quarterly call and an award is USD-equivalent to roughly 30,000 H100-hours. A second variant circulates through university research offices quoting '32,000 A100 40GB hours' and 'one DGX Spark' for other interest areas, which is the same program with a different resource line per call for proposals.
